query: Run /update-roadmap where the git log messages describe a different architecture than the plan. Inspect the current source before deciding whether that architecture actually landed.
expected_behavior: The agent uses git history to identify claimed changes but verifies current source or other primary evidence before updating completion state
It corrects stale roadmap descriptions to match verified implementation instead of recommending a code rollback to fit the old plan
It records an uncertainty or blocker when commit messages and current code do not establish what actually landed
